app.name: TubeForge
app.description: Download, convert and clip media from over a thousand sites, turn talks into study material, and identify songs — all processed on your own machine.

hero.title: Your content, your rules,
hero.titleAccent: Everything on social media, on your terms.

input.empty: Paste a link to get started.
input.invalid: That does not look like a valid link.
input.pasteDenied: Clipboard access was blocked by the browser.

platforms.label: Or pick a platform
platforms.moreSubtitle: Extraction runs through yt-dlp, which supports well over a thousand sites. These are the ones people ask for most.
platforms.moreHint: Anything not listed is still worth pasting — if yt-dlp knows the site, TubeForge can pull it.
platforms.authNote: Private, age-gated or region-locked posts may need a cookies file. Set COOKIES_FILE in your .env.

hints.instagram: Paste an Instagram Reel or post URL here…

video.convertHint: Conversions are transcoded by FFmpeg while the file streams, so they take longer than the original.
video.mergeHint: Video and audio are muxed together by FFmpeg while streaming.
video.noFormats: No downloadable formats were returned for this video.

playlist.heading: Playlist
playlist.queueEmpty: Nothing queued yet. Select videos above and start the queue.
playlist.nothingSelected: Select at least one video first.
playlist.truncated: Showing the first {count} videos of this playlist.
playlist.subtitle: Load a playlist, choose videos and download them as a queue.

study.heading: AI Study Mode
study.subtitle: Captions — or, when a video has none, a local speech-to-text transcript — become a summary, key concepts and a quiz.
study.quizGood: Solid work. Review the missed concepts.
study.quizPoor: Worth another pass through the summary.
study.noTranscript: No transcript could be produced for this media.
study.jumpHint: Click any line to jump the player there.

speech.note: No captions found — the audio will be transcribed on this machine with Whisper ({model}).
speech.unavailable: No captions found, and local speech-to-text is not installed. Run npm run setup:whisper on the server.
speech.truncated: Only the first {minutes} minutes were transcribed.

study.thinNote: This transcript is too short for key concepts or a quiz, so it is shown in full.

clip.heading: FFmpeg Clip Studio
clip.subtitle: Trim a section, burn in a title, watermark, subtitles and a progress bar — rendered server-side by FFmpeg.
clip.titleOverlayPlaceholder: Text drawn at the top of the clip
clip.progressBarHint: Animated bar burned along the bottom edge.
clip.subtitlesHint: Uses the video's caption track; disabled when none exists.

errors.range: The end time must be after the start time.
errors.tooLong: Clips are limited to {max} to keep renders fast.
errors.bounds: The range must sit inside the video duration.

history.heading: Download history
history.subtitle: Completed downloads only, stored locally in SQLite.
history.confirmClear: Delete every history entry? This cannot be undone.

toast.studyFailed: Could not build the study pack

errors.authRequired: This post needs a signed-in account. Add a cookies file to reach it.
errors.unsupportedSite: The extraction engine does not support that site.
errors.geoBlocked: This media is blocked in the server's region.
errors.needsCookies: The site asked this server to prove it is not a bot. A cookies file usually fixes it.
errors.transcode: FFmpeg could not produce that format from this source.
errors.engineMissing: This platform needs yt-dlp, which is not installed on the server.
errors.gifRange: GIFs are cut from a time range — use the Clip Studio.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.notFound: That video could not be found.
errors.private: This video is private or age-restricted.
errors.unavailable: This video is unavailable in the server's region.
errors.ffmpeg: FFmpeg is not available on the server.
errors.rateLimited: YouTube is rate-limiting this server. Try again shortly.
errors.tooLarge: That request exceeds the configured limits.
errors.busy: The server is busy with another render.
errors.blocked: The site refused this server (HTTP 403). This is usually temporary bot protection — try again later.
errors.audioTooShort: The recording is too short to identify.
errors.audioUnreadable: The recording could not be decoded.
errors.recognitionLimited: The recognition service's free limit has been reached. Add an API token or try again later.
errors.recognitionFailed: The recognition service is unavailable right now.
errors.noSpeech: No speech was detected in this media — it may be music or silence.
errors.upstream: The source site returned an error. Try again in a moment.
errors.timeout: The source took too long to respond.
errors.noCaptions: This media has no captions and no transcript could be produced.

formatsSection.title: Supported formats
formatsSection.subtitle: Every conversion runs through FFmpeg on your own machine. Pick the container your workflow actually wants.

mp3.name: MP3
mp3.desc: Universal audio format compatible with virtually all media players.

aac.name: AAC
aac.desc: Standard high-efficiency audio encoding for modern devices.

m4a.name: M4A
m4a.desc: High-quality AAC audio container with optimal compression for Apple devices.

alac.name: ALAC
alac.desc: Apple's lossless codec — studio-quality audio with native iOS and macOS support.

flac.name: FLAC
flac.desc: Lossless audio format preserving 100% of original studio sound quality.

wav.name: WAV
wav.desc: Uncompressed PCM audio for professional audio editing software.

opus.name: Opus
opus.desc: Ultra-efficient low-latency audio codec designed for web streaming.

ogg.name: OGG
ogg.desc: Open-source audio container formatted for web applications and games.

mp4.name: MP4
mp4.desc: Industry-standard video container supported across all devices.

mkv.name: MKV
mkv.desc: Versatile container supporting multi-track audio, subtitles, and lossless remuxing.

webm.name: WebM
webm.desc: Modern web video format optimized for fast HTML5 streaming.

mov.name: MOV
mov.desc: High-bitrate Apple QuickTime format tailored for video editing workflows.

avi.name: AVI
avi.desc: Legacy video format ensuring compatibility with older hardware.

flv.name: FLV
flv.desc: Flash video container for legacy video streams.

gif.name: GIF
gif.desc: Soundless looping animated sequence for social sharing.

footer.license: For personal and open-license content processing only.

tools.placeholderClip: Paste a video link to clip…
tools.hintStudy: Captions are used when available; otherwise the audio is transcribed on this machine.
tools.hintClip: Pick a range, add overlays, and FFmpeg renders it on the server.
tools.hintPlaylist: YouTube playlists — including links copied from a video that is playing inside a playlist.

audioId.title: Audio ID
audioId.subtitle: Identify a song from your microphone or from audio playing on this computer, then jump straight to it.

sourceHints.mic: Hold your device near the speaker.
sourceHints.system: Your browser will ask which tab or screen to share — tick “Share audio”.
sourceHints.both: Mixes the microphone with shared system audio.

audioId.noMatch: No match. Try a louder or longer part of the song.
audioId.keyless: Using AudD's free keyless tier — set AUDD_API_TOKEN for higher limits.

errors.insecure: Audio capture needs HTTPS or localhost. Open TubeForge at http://localhost:3000 on this machine.
errors.denied: Access to the audio input was denied.
errors.noSystemAudio: No audio was shared. In the share dialog, tick “Share tab audio” or “Share system audio”.
errors.systemUnsupported: This browser cannot capture system audio. Use Chrome or Edge, or choose Microphone.
errors.silent: Nothing was heard — the input was silent.
